title: usergroup.get
description: Retrieve user groups according to the given parameters.

status.description: Return only user groups with the given status. 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

userids.description: Return only user groups that contain the given users.

usrgrpids.description: Return only user groups with the given IDs.

selectTagFilters.description: Return user group tag based permissions in the tag_filters property. It has the following properties: groupid - (string) ID of the host group; tag - (string) tag name; value - (string) tag value.

selectUsers.description: Return the users from the user group in the users property. See user.get for restrictions based on user type.

selectRights.description: Return user group rights in the rights property. It has the following properties: permission - (integer) access level to the host group; id - (string) ID of the host group.

limitSelects.description: Limits the number of records returned by subselects.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: User group object properties to be returned. Since Zabbix 6.0.38, Admin and User type users may retrieve only the following properties: usrgrpid, name, gui_access, users_status, debug_mode. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values are: usrgrpid, name.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
